subject.title: feat: let agents remember across private conversations

question: Should OpenClaw make `memorySearch.rememberAcrossConversations` and the runtime-only `conversationRecall` plugin context supported public contracts after the doctor fix and clean exact-head validation?
rationale: This is a new user-facing mode and plugin authorization seam governing private transcript access; implementation tests cannot determine whether maintainers want to own that long-term product and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve the bounded contract after repair
options.body: Fix the doctor crash, obtain clean exact-head validation, and accept the default-off same-agent-private recall contract as supported product behavior.

options.title: Narrow or defer the surface
options.body: Keep the canonical feature request open and pause this branch if maintainers do not want the config key or plugin-context authorization API to become supported now.
